summary: Iteration 12 retest of the seller voice clone fixes. All 4 retest items PASS. (1) /api/voice/test failure now returns 424 with the friendly JSON message. Seen live: the UI 'Test seller voice' hit the 50 s HF timeout and the backend log shows 424 Failed Dependency. Cloudflare let it through and the UI showed the friendly VoxCPM2 busy text. The same result was confirmed in-process by forcing M.speak to fail (Khmer and English messages both correct). A mocked HTML 502 makes the Preview fall back to BUSY_KM for Khmer and to 'Voice preview failed' for English. (2) PUT /api/settings ignores seller_voice_media_id: cross-tenant injection does not persist, a stale save with '' keeps the sample, and seller_voice_text can be edited and is capped at 500. (3) seller-voice: transcription failure gives 424 with no orphan media doc, an empty transcript gives 400 'No speech found', text over 500 gives 422, and the 5–30 s rules are unchanged. (4) Widget voice: ai_reply is false when auto_reply is off (UI spinner stopped after 4.6 s, no AI message) and false when the conversation's ai_enabled is false. ai_reply true: the UI waited and showed the AI reply with audio after 6.6 s. Regression PASS: the seller block is visible on desktop and at 390 px (no overflow); the 17 s upload shows player, transcript, Remove and Test seller voice (clone engine 200 in 25 s via API); Remove goes back to the default voice; Test Khmer voice gives VoxCPM2 default (38 s); English Preview gives OpenAI; the Notion section renders.

minor.issue: seller_voice_text is still taken from the client while seller_voice_media_id is preserved. A stale tab, or any concurrent Save made while an upload is in progress, wipes the new transcript and keeps the new sample, so VoxCPM2 clones with an empty prompt_text. Reproduced by running the pytest workers in parallel: upload, then a concurrent PUT, left seller_voice_text ''. Suggest: if the client's text is empty and a stored sample exists, keep the stored text, or only accept text when the client's media id matches the stored one.
Still no business_id check when loading the seller sample (defense in depth). The PUT fix closes the main injection path.
A voice message with no speech (fake-mic beep) is saved as a user message with empty text. The widget bubble shows the audio and a blank text line.

issues: 'Replies instantly' is shown even when auto_reply is off
The uploaded sample <audio> shows 0:00 / 0:00 until it is played (metadata not preloaded). Cosmetic.
